llm.summary: This skill is a game-combat guide that openly describes high-impact in-game transactions, including raids and attacks, but its capabilities match its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Use requires structsd and a signing key for game transactions, which is proportionate for a skill that performs on-chain/game actions, but users should verify target IDs and consequences.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a Markdown skill file with metadata only; no installer, bundled executable, dependency setup, or remote payload execution is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to Structs gameplay decisions and documented structsd/MCP actions, with explicit verification and approval guidance before auto-submitted raid completion.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The nohup command creates a long-running raid-compute job with log and PID files under memory/jobs, but there is no cron, startup hook, service installation, or hidden cross-session backdoor behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly about Structs combat, raids, attacks, and defense; commands that move fleets, attack structs, and seize ore are high-impact in-game actions but are purpose-aligned and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend the agent to help with Structs combat. Before allowing commands, confirm the signing key, target IDs, fleet movement, and any -y auto-submit raid action, because mistakes can cause irreversible in-game attacks, exposed defenses, or ore loss.
llm.findings: [RA2] expected: The flagged nohup usage is part of a disclosed raid-compute workflow that may run minutes to hours and auto-submit completion after an approval block; this is job continuation for the game action, not unauthorized system persistence.
